audit.whatIsWrong: Five places claim Pantheon's passive 'Aegis' auto-blocks your basic attacks / Lightslinger shots. Pantheon has no such passive.
audit.why: His passive is Mortal Will — every few spells or attacks his next spell is empowered. The block is Aegis Assault (E), an active 22/21/20/19/18s channel at 400 range that makes him invulnerable to damage from the FRONT while he strikes. That is a button he spends, not a permanent tax on your autos, and it is directional and interruptible.
audit.corrected: Mortal Will = empowered next spell. Aegis Assault = active front-facing invulnerability, 18-22s, wait it out or get behind it. Never dump The Culling into an active Aegis Assault.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was scored Lucian in both layers while whys[4] on that exact row says Grand Starfall hands him a point-and-click all-in or a roam. First item and 2+ items were both Pantheon while whys[5] says the lane evens out and whys[6] says you out-damage him.
audit.why: 38.46% win rate, and the packet chart reads Pantheon at stage 5, Skill at 6, Lucian at 7 — identical to what the prose already said.
audit.corrected: win[4]/phases[4].side -> Pantheon; win[5]/phases[5].side -> Skill; win[6]/phases[6].side -> Lucian.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4..6].why carried the generic Lucian boilerplate — 'The Culling adds lane-clear', 'first item is your kill window' — which is the opposite of what this lane does.
audit.why: Grand Starfall is 180/165/150s with 5500 range: a roam threat as much as a lane threat. Lucian's actual reclaim is 2+ items, once Pantheon's front-loaded kit goes quiet.
audit.corrected: Level 6 = Grand Starfall; First item = the plateau; 2+ items = your window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every 'count Shield Vault' line gave no number, and none mentioned that it resets his auto.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9s and carries an autoReset flag — the damage arrives on the attack wind-up, not on a visible cast, so the retreat cue is earlier than players expect.
audit.corrected: Real cooldown plus the auto-reset tell written into dosFull[0]; Aegis Assault's 22s into dosFull[2].

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Grand Starfall (180s at rank 1) turns any step-up into an all-in or a free roam onto your mid.

edits.before: First item spike is your kill window — the dash-weave combo now deletes half bars. Force the issue before he stabilizes.
edits.after: His burst plateaus while your DPS climbs — this is where the lane levels out, so farm your spike rather than duel.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: Pantheon falls off hard into items while your Lightslinger DPS climbs — at 2+ items you win any extended fight.

edits.before: Both of you are strong level 1, but his Aegis auto-block blunts your Lightslinger and neither can commit yet — last-hit and wait.
edits.after: Both of you are strong level 1, but Mortal Will empowers his next spell every few casts and neither can commit yet — last-hit and wait.

edits.before: He stays favored as his empowered Q chunks you and his Aegis keeps blocking the shots your burst depends on.
edits.after: He stays favored as Mortal Will empowers Comet Spear and Aegis Assault blocks the burst you depend on.

edits.before: His Aegis passive auto-blocks one of your Lightslinger shots every few procs, gutting the burst your whole trade pattern relies on.
edits.after: Aegis Assault (E) makes him invulnerable from the front on an 18-22s cooldown, eating the burst your whole trade pattern relies on.

edits.before: Use his Aegis passive to auto-block your Lightslinger second shots and win every short trade
edits.after: Pop Aegis Assault to block your burst from the front, then unload once your Q is spent

edits.before: Pantheon owns this from level 2 on. His W is a point-click stun — there is nothing to dodge, so every time you step into auto range to throw a Q he can stun-cancel your Lightslinger and unload an empowered spear before your double-tap lands. His passive Aegis even auto-blocks one of your basic shots periodically, so the burst your whole kit is built around gets eaten. Don't trade autos with him; last-hit at max Q range, hold E, and accept you lose the lane bully mirror to a better one.
edits.after: Pantheon owns this from level 2 on. Shield Vault is a point-click stun — there is nothing to dodge, so every time you step into auto range to throw a Q he can stun you and unload an empowered Comet Spear before your double-tap lands. Aegis Assault then makes him invulnerable from the front, so the burst your whole kit is built around gets eaten by a 400-range shield. Don't trade autos with him; last-hit at max Q range, hold E, and accept you lose the lane bully mirror to a better one.

edits.before: Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9s and it resets his auto — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.

edits.before: Pantheon whiffs Shield Vault (Stun) and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Aegis Assault is 22s at rank 1 — wait it out, never burst into it.

edits.before: That is Pantheon’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Aegis Assault only blocks from the front — step behind him, or wait it out.

notes: The 'Aegis passive auto-blocks your autos' claim appeared in five places across both layers and is not in Pantheon's current kit — it reads like leftover pre-rework knowledge. It mattered: it told the reader their burst is permanently taxed, when in fact it is a 22-second directional channel they can walk behind or simply outlast. Mirror pantheon__lucian was already audited and made no level-chart claim, so these flips do not fight it; they follow the packet chart, which matches this page's own whys.
